name: Gale
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

You release a surge of wind out to medium range, which moves with you. The area becomes difficult terrain and all melee and ranged attack rolls made by creatures within the area or targeting a creature within the area are ill-favored (skip engagement).

Uncheck any number of Conditions. For each Condition you unchecked, choose one effect (choose two for Troubled):

  • The area extends out to long range.

  • Choose one creature within the area. It cannot attack or be targeted by attacks.

  • All damage against creatures within the area is halved.

  • Whenever a creature within the area would take damage, you may spend a reaction to redirect half of the damage to another creature adjacent to that creature.

  • You may spend a half action to push one creature within the area up to 10 feet in any direction.

Choose each effect only once.

Describe how you control the wind.
